item_short_desc: Rothco’s EMT Round Patch is a polyester patch with cotton thread. Embroidered on the front of the patch is Emergency Medical Technician, in blue thread. The Star of Life is also embroidered on the center of the patch, which is a global symbol of emergency medical service. Attaching this public safety patch onto a uniform and gear is a great way to help emergency personnel identify themselves. Rothco’s EMT patch measures 3” round.
